mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains depressed while TRANSIT stays below its recent levels, weekday footfall will stay weak and RETAIL_REC will remain lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days than over the prior 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining below baseline throughout the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in PARKS relative to the prior week signals reduced discretionary outing intensity, which spills into fewer retail visits and pushes RETAIL_REC down within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after a week-on-week PARKS drop larger than 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM rises while RESIDENTIAL also rises, short local errand concentration replaces shopping trips and RETAIL_REC weakens over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL are both above their recent averages.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed transit contraction, measured by TRANSIT dropping below its recent mean, indicates access friction or reduced mobility confidence that transmits to retail loss within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below the prior two-week average
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to weaken in the week after TRANSIT crosses below its prior two-week average.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS and RETAIL_REC both rebound after a trough week, the same weather or calendar shock is likely fading and retail mobility should improve over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns up after a two-week decline
failure_condition: PARKS rebounds for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the following 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility signals more time spent at home, which mechanically suppresses discretionary shopping trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 14 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above its prior four-week average.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES recovers but TRANSIT does not, commuting shifts to non-transit modes and the retail response is delayed, leaving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises while TRANSIT stays below baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES increasing and TRANSIT remaining below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM weakens while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES also stay depressed, the metro is in a broad demand slump and retail mobility will remain below its recent four-week average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the next week after GROCERY_PHARM turns negative week-on-week while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain depressed.
